from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545201/attempts/077c639e3ede471faa305f8b7291dc1f/system/state/workspace')
progdir=base/'programs'; progdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    # 8 is the static marker color; the other non-background diagonal strokes extend
    # away from the blocked side of each stroke.
    for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
        starts = []
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                color = grid[r][c]
                if color == background or color == 8:
                    continue
                pr, pc = r-dr, c-dc
                if 0 <= pr < h and 0 <= pc < w and grid[pr][pc] == color:
                    continue
                run = []
                rr, cc = r, c
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == color:
                    run.append((rr, cc))
                    rr += dr; cc += dc
                if len(run) >= 2:
                    starts.append((color, run))
        for color, run in starts:
            ends = ( (run[0][0]-dr, run[0][1]-dc, -dr, -dc),
                     (run[-1][0]+dr, run[-1][1]+dc, dr, dc) )
            rays=[]
            for r,c,sr,sc in ends:
                cells=[]
                while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w and grid[r][c] == background:
                    cells.append((r,c))
                    r += sr; c += sc
                rays.append(cells)
            # Extend on the open side; when both sides are open, use the longer ray.
            if rays[0] and rays[1]:
                chosen = rays[0] if len(rays[0]) > len(rays[1]) else rays[1]
            else:
                chosen = rays[0] or rays[1]
            for r,c in chosen:
                if out[r][c] == background:
                    out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
path=progdir/'task-8be60265.py'; path.write_text(code)
print(path, code)
